narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Viewport"**

The home is a live CAD model. Each room is a furnished dollhouse cut-away (two walls, a lit cut section, dark furniture) standing on a graphite floor that is the real construction grid. The devices are studio-rendered satin clay parts set on its walls, furniture tops, windows, door, floor and ceiling, each annotated by a leader-line callout carrying its true state. The grammar is Fusion 360 / Onshape: graphite ground, hairline panels, small radii, a technical grotesk with tabular figures, one selection lavender, and one pink that only ever means "physically on". It refuses the category default, a grid of rounded device tiles.

Depth lives in the renders, not in the chrome. The interface around the room is flat graphite planes separated by hairlines, so the room and its pink are the only things with volume or light. State changes happen in place: pink fades up, the lavender hatch resolves to solid, the value flips inside its own box, and nothing else moves.

The PC remote belongs to the same world: round hairline keys in ink, service logos in ink, and a trackpad drawn as a sketch plane (dot grid, crosshair under the finger, live x/y readout).
keyCharacteristics: Dark only: graphite grounds, built for evenings indoors.
Pink is the device's reported state, never a wish.
One state grammar everywhere: viewport, callouts, pick points, rows, sheet.
Pre-rendered studio views (Blender Cycles), composited in Flutter; no real-time 3D.
Barlow with tabular figures; condensed Barlow for annotation labels.
Rectangular parts with a 6px radius and hairline borders; only remote keys are round.

rules.name: The Observed Pink Rule
rules.body: Pink comes from the observed state only (`onLevel` in `app/lib/widgets/state.dart`). A pending wish never lights anything: the switch stays lavender, the text is lavender, the model is hatched, until the device confirms.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Lavender is interaction and waiting; pink is physical power; red is failure, alarm or destruction. A toggle that powers nothing (mute, invert scroll, a boolean `custom:` capability) is lavender, never pink.

rules.name: The Ink Logo Rule
rules.body: Service logos (Simple Icons, CC0, `app/assets/logos/`, see `app/tools/logos.md`) are drawn in ink like every other key, lavender when active. Brand colours are refused.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every changing number (summaries, percent, watts, volume, counts, host:port, trackpad coordinates) sets `fontFeatures: Hm.tabular` so values flip without jitter.

rules.name: The Two Facts Rule
rules.body: A summary (`summary()` in `widgets/state.dart`) says at most two facts joined by " · ": "On · 70 %", "On · 410 W", "Locked · Closed". Watts keep one decimal only under 10 W.

rules.name: The Light Is State Rule
rules.body: The only glows in the app are state: pink light passes (multiplied, plus a bloom, softer at 0.75 for screens and appliances), pink floor pools (0.13 for lamps, 0.24 for small-LED devices), a lavender selection halo or red failure halo behind the device silhouette. No decorative shadow or glow on UI chrome.

dos: **Do** route every state colour through `stateColor` / `onLevel` / `isPending` in `app/lib/widgets/state.dart`.
**Do** add a new capability by extending `CapabilityTile`, `capLabel` and, if it has a summary fact, `summary`; unknown `custom:*` capabilities must still render generically.

**Do** add a new model in three places together: geometry in `render.py`, an entry in `catalog` (`models.dart`) with anchor, scale and mounts, and a label in `widgets/model_names.dart`; then re-render and re-pack.
**Do** add a new room kind in `room.py` (all three sizes, its mounts), `roomKinds` and `inferRoomKind` in `rooms.dart`, and its FR/EN label.
**Do** add a remote key as a `_Round`: hairline ring, ink icon, lavender only when primary or selected, red only for destructive power.
**Do** keep values in place: changing numbers use `FlipText` and tabular figures, and layout never moves on a state change.
**Do** honour reduced motion (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations`): flips, easing and spin snap instantly.
donts: **Don't** light anything pink from a desired state, or use pink for a switch that powers nothing.
**Don't** colour service logos in their brand colours.
**Don't** add real-time 3D; extend the pre-rendered views and keep camera constants identical on both sides.
**Don't** choose a model or room from a brand or plugin name.
**Don't** add shadows, gradients or glows to UI chrome; light in this world is state.
**Don't** put device tiles in a grid; devices live in the room and in rows.
**Don't** expect light on walls: lit devices pool pink on the floor only; light spilling onto walls is not done yet.
